Bug_Details:
The field number passed into #findFieldByNumber belongs to a different proto to the Descriptor. A proto’s Descriptor was created by mixing the Descriptors class from one
proto with the field number from another. E.g.: Foo.getDescriptors().findFieldByNumber(Bar.ID_FIELD_NUMBER) Foo.getDescriptors().findFieldByNumber(Bar.ID_FIELD_NUMBER) This accesses the Descriptor of a field in Foo with a field number from
Bar. One of these was probably intended: Foo.getDescriptors().findFieldByNumber(Foo.ID_FIELD_NUMBER)
Bar.getDescriptors().findFieldByNumber(Bar.ID_FIELD_NUMBER) Foo.getDescriptors().findFieldByNumber(Foo.ID_FIELD_NUMBER)
Bar.getDescriptors().findFieldByNumber(Bar.ID_FIELD_NUMBER)
Bug_Explanation: The bug is caused by mixing descriptors from different classes. The method `findFieldByNumber` is called on the Descriptor of Foo with a field number from Bar, which is not correct. The correct usage would involve using the field number from the same class as the Descriptor.
Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by calling showBug method which uses Foo's descriptor to find a field number from Bar, resulting in incorrect behavior and a failed assertion.
